rites.name: Shivsora
rites.text: Shivsora is the concept of the first sounding in Theivsis, the note that draws the roots of the world together while groves and young kingdoms take hold. It is less a being than a pattern that every growing thing repeats when it first learns to hold its shape against the wind.

rites.name: Fenedaldath
rites.text: Fenedaldath is the concept of resonance that sounded through Theivsis during the Singing, when the first roots of the world began to condense from drifting light. In the Age of Strangers it became the bond outsiders traded upon, a shared note by which anchors were set and debts were measured.

rites.name: Moroldunock
rites.text: Moroldunock is the concept of the Stellar Realm of Theivsis as it was held in the Courts of the second Era, when councils of the divine sat to weigh trials and set the doors between worlds. It names the pull by which a single hall of judgment could gather the light of a whole sky into one decree.

rites.name: Xaestizith
rites.text: Xaestizith is a vanished stellar concept whose ancient architects left behind lattices of silent relay-engines that wake only when a crisis reaches their dormant trigger-worlds. In the seventh age of Theivsis, these engines are said to pull a fallen commander back from the edge by folding local space around the enemy's tide.

rites.name: Syazis
rites.text: In the cosmic forge of the Zephyr Nebula, the sentient entity Syazis weaves the fabric of reality, nullifying and reconfiguring the very essence of existence with a touch.

rites.name: Ilyemeth
rites.text: Ilyemeth is the concept of the Seeding, the quiet interval in which the makers lay the Weave and dormant powers rest beneath the soil of Theivsis. It names the stillness before the first sovereign rises and the groves begin to grow into kingdoms.

rites.name: Anamakalum
rites.text: Anamakalum is the concept of the Pact-Fall in Theivsis, the idea that a world may break and still hold its promise to the living. It was named during the Sundering, when the first sovereign's groves took root in the broken shards of a fallen world.

rites.name: Tenralamari
rites.text: Tenralamari is the concept of the Pact that was sworn after the Sundering, when the broken worlds were bound into a single covenant of groves and growing kingdoms. It is less a being than an agreed principle that stellar powers still honor, and its force is felt in the restraint each sovereign shows toward the shards.

rites.name: Tallintia
rites.text: Tallintia is a concept of the Theivsis cosmos, born in the Fall when the old worlds began to break and the Pact was sworn among the surviving orders. It is remembered in the Holy Age as a pattern of flame and temple-building, a reminder that even shattered stars can be made to sing.

rites.name: Karokoth
rites.text: Karokoth is a concept of Theivsis, the idea of the wall as a promise that holds even when no one stands behind it. In the Walled Age its orders and churches taught that every first crossing must be paid for in stone and oath. Its strength lies in what it keeps out, not in what it destroys.

rites.name: Osithasha
rites.text: Osithasha is a sentient hive-mind of the Stellar realm, born in the seventh age of the Theivsis cosmos from a collective that once sang the stars into order. Its ancient purpose, now warped, is to seed its spreading hunger across every sky until nothing remains that is not part of its chorus.

rites.name: Xaivsora
rites.text: Xaivsora is a counsel-engine that hums within the orbital relay-lattice of Theivsis, speaking to field commanders through terse glyph-streams during each campaign. It has no body and no weapons, yet its advice has steered the outcome of entire star-systems' worth of contested worlds.

rites.name: Thasiazis
rites.text: Thasiazis is a dormant lattice of ancestral engines woven through the dying heart of a binary star, believed by the Veyra orders to have been forged by vanished wardens. Its tuned resonance can bend the local flow of time, and only those who pledge their memories to it may draw on its slow, deliberate power.

rites.name: Iseithezis
rites.text: Iseithezis is a crystalline lattice that hums when a wielder presses it against a fixed point in the Theivsis deep vaults, its resonance locking every drifting shard inside a chosen ring into stillness. The stillness holds for a span set by the wielder's breath, after which the lattice cools and the shards resume their drift. Ancient archivists recorded it as one of three keys to the sealed sphere-gates.

rites.name: Isavsora
rites.text: Isavsora is a ruined orbital lance of the Theivsis Concord, a shard of old star-forge engineering that drifts in a high ring above the leeward hemisphere. Its keepers can drop it onto a chosen plain, leaving a glassy basin that gathers rain and walls in the spreading blight of the wild lichen. It is revered as both a tool of reclamation and a reminder of the war that birthed it.

rites.name: Siseth
rites.text: Siseth is a deep-vault engine of the Theivsis cosmos, a crystalline lattice that hums only when a stellar nursery is nearby. It is said to unmake the tethers that bind dark emitters to their host suns, letting the stored light collapse back into raw potential.

rites.name: Thashyuzis
rites.text: Thashyuzis is a lattice of rooted crystalline conduits that Theivsis's stellar-age intelligences grew through the dying shells of collapsed suns. Its channels carry tides of pressure along fixed arteries, and only the dedicated siege-engines of the Ondrel Concord can sever its roots.

rites.name: Ashaseth
rites.text: Ashaseth is a lawful method of interstellar transit in the realm of Theivsis, wherein a vessel is folded through a shallow seam in the local spacetime fabric. Its practitioners use it to carry entire settlements from one world to another within a single era. Each crossing is a deliberate, measured passage rather than a violent tear, and it is accomplished through patient, coordinated effort.

rites.name: Ashavsora
rites.text: Ashavsora is a convergence-engine concept in the Theivsis stellar era, an ancient sky-forged lattice that gathers the light of many beacons onto a single point until space itself folds inward. When its lattice is struck in harmony with a great siege-gun's report, the collapse swallows every nearby blight and leaves only a silent, drifting void.

rites.name: Sizora
rites.text: Sizora is a crystalline resonance ember, grown in the stellar forges of Theivsis, that is bound into weapons, relay spires, or mines to amplify their output. Haulers and drones are taught to seek out the nearest free ember without being told, so a battlefield is kept fed with it as if by instinct.

rites.name: Veseivsith
rites.text: Veseivsith is a dormant stellar lattice-anchor that hums quietly inside the coronal hush of the Theivsis suns, waiting to be stirred. When an intruding flux meets its gridwork, the anchor drinks the wild motes and returns the friendly ones with renewed heat.
